title: Similar String Groups
summary: Given a list of strings where each string is an anagram of every other string in the list, determine how many groups of similar strings exist.
statement: Given a list of strings where each string is an anagram of every other string in the list, determine how many groups of similar strings exist. Two strings are considered similar if they can be made identical by swapping at most two letters in distinct positions within one of the strings.
constraints: All strings are distinct anagrams of equal length.
Two strings are similar when equal or when swapping exactly two positions in one makes the other.
Return the number of connected similarity groups.
hints: Compare every pair by counting mismatched positions.
Union pairs with zero or two mismatches.
For anagrams, exactly two mismatches are precisely one swap; union-find closes similarity transitively.
editorial: For anagrams, exactly two mismatches are precisely one swap; union-find closes similarity transitively.
